Segnala offerta di lavoro Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Visable Giulia Gilardi Giulia Gilardi HR Manager Italy & Spain Informazioni sull’azienda: Visable, filiale europea di Alibaba e leader nei marketplace B2B in Europa, aiuta le PMI a trovare nuovi clienti e sviluppare il proprio business sui mercati internazionali attraverso Europages e WLW, le nostre piattaforme B2B disponibili in 26 lingue. Da oltre 30 anni supportiamo le aziende nella loro crescita commerciale e oggi siamo in una fase di forte espansione in Europa. Per rafforzare il nostro team commerciale in Italia, cerchiamo un/a Customer Acquisition Manager che ci aiuti a sviluppare nuove opportunità di business, acquisire nuovi clienti e far crescere Visable sul mercato italiano. Le tue principali responsabilità saranno: Gestire l’intero ciclo di vendita, dalla ricerca di nuovi prospect alla presa di contatto, dalla demo alla negoziazione e alla chiusura. Individuare e acquisire nuovi clienti B2B, comprendendo le loro esigenze e proponendo le soluzioni più adatte, tra cui Europages, WLW, Google Ads, Google Shopping e retargeting. Parlare con imprenditori e decision maker, costruendo relazioni commerciali solide e accompagnandoli nel percorso di acquisto. Gestire il tuo portafoglio clienti, assicurando un’esperienza positiva e mantenendo una relazione costante nel tempo. Monitorare la tua attività e i tuoi risultati attraverso i nostri strumenti interni, condividendo feedback e idee per migliorare i risultati del team. Formazione e supporto: Fin dal tuo ingresso in Visable, riceverai una formazione completa sui nostri prodotti, sulle soluzioni e sui metodi di vendita. Avrai a disposizione ogni giorno una base lead, oltre a strumenti digitali che ti aiuteranno nella gestione della tua attività, tra cui Sugar CRM, software di follow-up automatico e simulatori per la gestione dei prospect. Profilo: Hai almeno 2 anni di esperienza nella vendita di soluzioni digitali (l’esperienza nel telemarketing, nella vendita telefonica o in ambito B2B sarà considerata un plus). Hai una forte attitudine commerciale, sei determinato/a e orientato/a al risultato. Ti motivano gli obiettivi e non ti scoraggi davanti a un “no”. Hai ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali e sai creare rapidamente un rapporto di fiducia con i clienti, anche al primo contatto. Sei una persona autonoma, organizzata e proattiva, che sa gestire le proprie attività e lavorare per obiettivi. Hai una buona dimestichezza con i principali strumenti digitali e informatici. Cosa offriamo: Contratto a tempo determinato o indeterminato, commisurato alla tua esperienza nel ruolo. Modalità di lavoro ibrida: 50% in ufficio e 50% smart working, combinando la flessibilità del lavoro da remoto con i vantaggi della collaborazione in team presso il nostro ufficio di Milano (MM3 Lodi Tibb). Pacchetto retributivo: €29K di fisso + €33K di variabile target (OTE €62K), con una componente variabile senza tetto, pagata mensilmente in base ai risultati raggiunti. Buoni pasto da €10 al giorno. Tutti gli strumenti e device necessari per svolgere al meglio il tuo lavoro. Diversity & Inclusion: In Visable crediamo nella diversità, nell’inclusione e nelle pari opportunità. Abbiamo firmato la Diversity Charter e promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro in cui ogni persona possa sentirsi rispettata e valorizzata. Con oltre 50 nazionalità e più di 20 lingue parlate, siamo orgogliosi di essere un’azienda realmente internazionale. For more than fifty years, the company has developed highly technical solutions, combining engineering expertise with a deep understanding of riders' needs and the motorcycle community. As part of a new phase of growth, the company is strengthening its marketing function to further consolidate brand positioning, develop new market opportunities, and create an increasingly effective connection between products, distribution channels, and the end-customer experience. Position Overview The Marketing Manager will be responsible for translating brand strategy, product priorities, and commercial objectives into impactful marketing initiatives. Reporting to the Head of Creation & Marketing, the successful candidate will lead the execution of campaigns, product launches, and brand activation activities, ensuring alignment between strategy and execution, while coordinating efforts across Marketing, Product Management, Sales, Headquarters, E-commerce, and external partners. The role also includes the management of a team of three professionals: two dedicated to Social Media and one focused on Marketing Operations & Internal Communications. Key Responsibilities Marketing Strategy, Planning & Market Intelligence Develop and execute integrated marketing plans based on brand, product, and business strategies defined in collaboration with the Head of Creation & Marketing. Drive the implementation of the annual marketing calendar through campaigns, product launches, and market activation initiatives. Lead market intelligence activities by analyzing industry trends, consumer insights, market dynamics, and the competitive landscape to support strategic decision-making. Conduct benchmarking activities and strategic evaluations, including SWOT analyses, to identify strengths, areas for improvement, opportunities, and potential risks. Ensure a consistent brand experience across all consumer, retail, digital, event, and partnership touchpoints. Project Governance, Product Launch & Go-to-Market Manage marketing project governance by defining scope, deliverables, responsibilities, and timelines. Coordinate the operational planning and execution of product launches, ensuring an effective go-to-market process. Monitor project progress, operational challenges, and potential risks, proactively addressing issues to ensure milestone achievement. Brand Activation & Campaign Management Translate brand strategy and creative direction into integrated campaigns and market activation programs. Coordinate campaign rollout across multiple touchpoints, including consumers, dealers, media, events, and partnerships. Ensure consistency between creative outputs, brand positioning, and commercial and operational requirements. Sales & Retail Enablement Collaborate closely with the Sales function to understand market needs, commercial priorities, and distribution network requirements. Develop tools, assets, and supporting materials to enable Sales teams and retail partners to effectively promote products and strengthen brand value. Team, Cross-functional & Partner Management Lead and develop a Marketing team of three professionals: two focused on Social Media and digital content, and one dedicated to Marketing Operations & Internal Communications. Ensure effective cross-functional collaboration across Marketing, Product Management, Sales, Headquarters, E-commerce, and local markets. Monitor marketing investments and project budgets in collaboration with the relevant internal stakeholders. Performance & Continuous Improvement Analyze performance and business results through reporting tools and data-driven methodologies. Identify opportunities to improve marketing processes, tools, and operating practices. Contribute to the development of a structured, proactive, and results-oriented Marketing organization. Candidate Profile Minimum 5-6 years of experience in Marketing Manager, Brand Manager, Product Marketing Manager, or similar roles, preferably within structured and international organizations. Proven experience in managing integrated marketing plans, multi-channel campaigns, brand activation initiatives, and product launches, with the ability to translate brand strategies and commercial objectives into tangible business actions. Demonstrated success in managing complex projects involving multiple functions, markets, agencies, and external partners, supported by strong project management and stakeholder management skills. Ability to combine strategic thinking, analytical capabilities, and a strong execution focus, leveraging data, market insights, and commercial information to drive informed decision-making. Structured and proactive approach, with strong autonomy and the ability to manage dynamic environments with multiple priorities while anticipating challenges and identifying practical solutions. Prior experience within the motorcycle, automotive, sports, premium consumer goods, or lifestyle sectors will be considered a strong advantage. Excellent command of the English language.
